item.tib: dpal ldan lha mo yang snying gi rgyud las bzlog pa'i skabs sgron tha ram lde mig
item.coloph: skabs sgron tha ram lde mig 'di/ a las bskyed pa'i 'byung ming can/ dbyar gyi sprin sgra los sbyar nongs/ mkhas pa gdong lnga can la bzod/ ma rung log lta brang 'gro'i dbang / spang zan lte dri ltar gyur kyang / grogs kyi rta bdun 'od zer gyis/ bdag blo'i chu skyes pad mo bskul/ skyes chen rnams kyi mdzad srol ltar/ bgyis pa thag khra sbrul gral 'changs/ dkar chag yi ge bris pa 'di/ bla ma yi dam rnams la bshags/ mkha' 'gro bon skyongs rnams la bzod / 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa thob shog/
